data.one_liner: WebView widget implementation for Flutter web.
data.what_it_does: Provides a WebView widget for Flutter apps running on the web. Currently only supports loading a URL via loadRequest and loading raw HTML via loadHtmlString. It mirrors part of the webview_flutter API for web platforms.
use_when: You need to embed web content in a Flutter web app using the familiar webview_flutter API.
You want a simple way to display external pages or HTML strings on web without native plugins.
avoid_when: You require full WebView features like JavaScript channels, navigation controls, or file uploads.
You need a production‑ready, feature‑complete webview solution.
strengths: Shares API with the main webview_flutter plugin, easing code sharing across platforms.
Works out‑of‑the‑box on web with minimal native code.
weaknesses: Limited to loadRequest and loadHtmlString; many features are missing.
May not be suitable for complex web interactions.
data.setup_notes: Add both webview_flutter and webview_flutter_web as dependencies; the web package requires extra setup as described in its README.
